## Critical limitation

`/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/` does **not** contain WearfitPro native source — only docs, inventory, and scripts. Actual code is expected at gitignored `native_app/source_code/` (see `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/docs/01-概述/源码获取.md`). Per `native-locate` rules, **implementation details below come from inventory + migration docs + Flutter code**, not from reading `.kt`/`.m` files.

## 1. Account & Security (账号与安全)

### Native inventory paths (logical map only)

| Platform | Module | Path (relative to `native_app/source_code/`) | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Android | `feature-user` (106 files) | `WearfitPro-feat-zsc-wakeok_theme_variant/feature-user/` | User/account flows |
| iOS | `Mine` (574 files) | `wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/Mine/` | “我的” tab — settings, profile, points, etc. |
| iOS | `LoginAndRegiest` (85 files) | `wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/LoginAndRegiest/` | Login/register |

Documented in:
- `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/docs/06-迁移/功能迁移清单.md` (row: 用户注册 / 个人资料)
- `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/inventory/01-android-modules.md`
- `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/inventory/02-ios-modules.md`

### API endpoints (Flutter already knows)

From `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/account/feature_account_auth/lib/src/service/auth_api_paths.dart`:

| Endpoint | Purpose | Flutter status |
|---|---|---|
| `POST user/login` | Password login | Done |
| `POST user/platformlogin` | Third-party login | Done |
| `POST user/fast/login` | One-key login | Done |
| `POST sysCode/sendcode` | SMS code (signed) | Done |
| `POST user/valid/platformBindPhone` | Validate bind phone | Done (bind flow) |
| `POST user/platformBindPhone` | Conflict resolution | Done |
| `POST user/set/password` | Set password after bind | Done |
| `POST user/phone/register` | Register | Done |
| `POST user/reset/password` | Forgot password (unauthenticated) | Done |
| `GET user/auth/personal/allInfo` | Profile fetch | Done |
| `POST user/v2/auth/personal/userAllInfoUpdate` | Profile update | Done |

**Not in Flutter `AuthApiPaths` (expected for 账号与安全 gaps):**
- Change phone (logged-in) — likely new `user/...` path in native `feature-user` / `Mine`
- Change password (logged-in) — distinct from `user/reset/password` and `user/set/password`
- Delete account / 永久注销 — no path in repo

Migration checklist explicitly marks **账号注销** and **改密（已登录态）** as still TODO.

### Navigation flow

**Native (inferred):** `Mine` / `feature-user` → dedicated “账号与安全” sub-page → change phone / change password / delete account / logout.

**Flutter today (`glasses_app`):**

```
我的 Tab (ProfilePage)
  → tap header → /profile/personal-info (PersonalInfoPage) OR /login
  → 设置 row → /device/settings (DeviceSettingsPage)   ← device BLE settings, NOT account security
```

Logout exists in:
- `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/widget/account/widget_account_auth/lib/src/pages/profile_page.dart` (auth widget profile)
- `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_shell/personal_info_page.dart` (via auth flows)

`AuthService.logout()` only clears local token/session (`/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/account/feature_account_auth/lib/src/service/auth_service_impl.dart`) — no server-side logout API referenced.

### Flutter vs missing

| Feature | Flutter | Missing |
|---|---|---|
| Login / register / forgot password | Yes | — |
| Profile view/edit (nickname, avatar, gender, etc.) | Yes (`PersonalInfoPage`, `ProfilePage`) | — |
| Logout (local) | Yes | Server revoke (if native has one) |
| **账号与安全 page** | No | Dedicated settings sub-page |
| **修改手机号** (logged-in) | No (bind-phone only for third-party) | Page + API |
| **修改密码** (logged-in) | No | Page + API |
| **永久注销** | No | Page + API + confirmation flow |

## 2. Agreements & Terms (协议与条款)

### Native references

| Item | Path / note |
|---|---|
| H5 container | Android `module-h5` (3 files) — `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/inventory/01-android-modules.md` |
| iOS WebView | “WebView 路径” — `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/inventory/07-native-feature-migration-matrix.md` |
| Terms in login | Umeng one-key login supports `privacyOne` / `privacyTwo` URL pairs — `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/common/external_auth/common_external_auth_umeng/vendor/umeng_verify_sdk/lib/umeng_verify_sdk.dart` |

No committed doc lists **user agreement / privacy policy H5 URLs** for a settings “协议与条款” page. Those URLs are almost certainly in native `Mine` / `feature-user` or remote config — requires `source_code/` checkout.

### H5 URLs Flutter already uses (help/tutorials, not legal terms)

| Path | Example URL |

| `/h5/faqOperating` | `https://help.iwhop.cn/h5/faqOperating?lang=zh&hideTitle=true` |
| `/h5/setGlasses` | `https://help.iwhop.cn/h5/setGlasses?lang=zh&isJump=false` |
| `/h5/voiceAssistant` | `https://help.iwhop.cn/h5/voiceAssistant?lang=zh` |
| `/h5/keyDesc2` | `https://help.iwhop.cn/h5/keyDesc2?lang=zh&hideTitle=true` |
| `/h5/faqGlasses1` | `https://help.iwhop.cn/h5/faqGlasses1?lang=zh` |
| `/h5/sportPermissionSettingIndex` | `https://help.iwhop.cn/h5/sportPermissionSettingIndex?lang=zh` |

| `/h5/videoTutorialIndex` | `https://help.iwhop.cn/h5/videoTutorialIndex?lang=zh` |

Hosts whitelisted in `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/app/feature_h5/lib/src/config/h5_host_allowlist.dart`: `help.iwhop.cn`, `help.iwhop.com`, `test.iwhopro.com`.

### Navigation flow

**Flutter:**
- Tutorial tab → `openH5()` → `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/app/feature_h5/lib/src/routing/open_h5.dart` → `H5Page`
- Login: checkbox text “我已阅读并同意《用户协议》和《隐私政策》” — **not tappable**, no URL (`/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/widget/account/widget_account_auth/lib/src/widgets/auth_login_controls.dart`)
- Profile “关于” → bottom sheet with version only — **no terms links** (`/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_shell/profile_page.dart`)

### Flutter vs missing

| Feature | Flutter | Missing |
|---|---|---|
| H5 WebView container + allowlist | `feature_h5` | — |
| Tutorial/help H5 URLs | `GlassesHelpUrls` | — |
| Login agreement gate (checkbox) | Yes | Tappable links to legal H5 |
| **协议与条款 settings page** | No | List + navigation to user agreement / privacy policy URLs |
| Legal H5 URL constants | No | Need from native `Mine` / `feature-user` or backend config |

## 3. Clear cache (清理缓存)

### Native references (indirect only)

| Storage/cache layer | Native | Flutter |
|---|---|---|
| KV | Android MMKV; iOS `KVCache` | `core_storage` (`shared_preferences`, `flutter_secure_storage`) |
| Image cache | iOS SDWebImage (Podfile) | `cached_network_image` in `common_ui` |
| DB | Room / WCDB | Not migrated |

**No** `clearCache`, 清理缓存, or cache-clearing activity is indexed anywhere in committed `native_app/`.

### What native likely clears (hypothesis — needs source verification)

Typical WearfitPro “清理缓存” would clear some mix of:
- Image/disk cache (Glide/SDWebImage)
- Downloaded media / temp FTP files
- Non-auth MMKV keys
- Possibly WebView cache

**Not** documented in this repo; must grep native `Mine` / `feature-user` after checkout.

### Flutter vs missing

| Feature | Flutter | Missing |
|---|---|---|
| App “清理缓存” UI | No | Page + size display + confirm dialog |
| Cache clear service | No | Orchestrate image cache, temp dirs, optional KV keys |
| Preserve auth session on clear | N/A | Policy from native |

## 4. Language / theme (多语言 / 多主题)

### Native

| Capability | Android | iOS | Migration status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Theme/skin | `module-theme`, `commonui` | `PHSkinSystem` | Migrated → `core_theme` (light); **dark theme backlog** |
| i18n | Native resources | Native resources | Per-package `gen-l10n`; “设置/录音仍有 backlog” per `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/inventory/07-native-feature-migration-matrix.md` |
| Device language | BLE `setBandLanguage` | Watch settings | Separate from app UI language |

### Flutter

| Package / file | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/widget/app/widget_app_settings/` | Bottom-sheet: account, **language** (system/zh/en), **theme** (system/light/dark), logout |
| `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app_state.dart` | `glassesThemeModeProvider`, `glassesLocaleProvider` — **persisted, no profile UI** |
| `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/pkg_showcase/lib/src/home_page.dart` | Only app wired to `AppSettingsMenu` |

`glasses_app` profile “设置” routes to **device** settings (`/device/settings`), not app language/theme.

### Flutter vs missing

| Feature | Flutter | Missing |
|---|---|---|
| Theme/locale state + persistence | Yes (`app_state.dart`) | UI in `glasses_app` profile/settings |
| `AppSettingsMenu` widget | Yes | Not used in `glasses_app` |
| Dark theme tokens | Partial backlog | Full dark `DesignTokens` |
| Extended locales | No | Framework per migration checklist |

---

## Summary: Flutter has vs missing

| Area | Has | Missing |
|---|---|---|
| **账号与安全** | Login, bind-phone, register, forgot password, profile, local logout | Dedicated page; change phone; change password (logged-in); delete account; server logout |
| **协议与条款** | Login checkbox copy; H5 infra; tutorial URLs | Settings list; legal H5 URLs; tappable agreement links on login |
| **清理缓存** | Low-level storage/image cache libs | User-facing clear-cache feature |
| **多语言/多主题** | `core_theme`, per-package l10n, `widget_app_settings`, glasses providers | Profile/settings UI in `glasses_app`; dark theme; extended languages |
